messages:
alyssa: heads up — we saw a customer hit an auto‑fallback loop when their canary had transient latency spikes. can we sketch operator UX to make this obvious?
mike: ugh. is the loop because fallback triggered -> canary picks up -> fallback retriggers?
priya: yea, it was: primary -> degraded variant -> primary retries on timeout -> cache cold -> repeat.
sam: hmm. that's the oscillation case we talked about. We should show feedback in the rollout widget: 'currently degraded due to latency' + last 10 events.
alyssa: +1. Also need a clear operator override path that doesn’t disable audit logs. people want a quick kill switch without losing the trace.
mike: operator override should be a 2-click: pause auto-fallback (with TTL) or force-fallback (persist). both write an audit event with why and who.
priya: we have audit events, but they’re noisy. proposal: surface a summarized correlation id in the UI and link to the event stream. e.g., Correlation: cf-2024-4812.
sam: can we auto-attach the most recent error class to the rollback CTA? button reads: "Pause auto-fallback — reason: latency spike (p99=2.3s)"
alyssa: love that. also want a small banner when autoswitching happens: "Autoswitched to variant-beta (fallback) — 8 requests/sec — click to inspect"
mike: question: should pause be scoped to route, model, or deployment? ops asked for both route-level and global.
priya: default to route-level, but allow a global (org) toggle with explanation. keep fine-grained controls for SREs.
alyssa: telemetry-wise, we need a sampling of payloads for 'why' debugging. but keep PII out. maybe sample headers+latency+error-class.
ops-runbook-bot: INCIDENT NOTE: fallback oscillation pattern detected for customer-id: cust-42 at 2024-06-12T14:03Z. Suggested action: pause auto-fallback for route /chat and run sim.
mike: about the confirm modal: include the audit message textbox (required) and suggested tags: latency, cache-cold, rollout-heat.
priya: UX microcopy: instead of 'disable' use 'pause auto-fallback' and show TTL input with default 15m, options 5m/15m/1h/custom.
sam: for longer investigations, we need an 'escape hatch' that enters monitor-only mode (no automatic switch, but still records potential fallback candidates).
alyssa: implementation note: add a status flag in the routing API: fallback_policy_override = {type: paused|forced, scope: route|model|org, expires_at, actor, reason_id}.
mike: can we also emit an event to the rollout timeline so product sees when ops intervened?
priya: yes — timeline entry + linkback to audit event. timeline should show actor and TTL.
alyssa: ok gonna draft a lightweight mock for console: small banner, 2-click pause with reason box, timeline entry, link to event stream. i'll drop PNG in Figma.
priya: thanks — i'll update API contract and add tests for oscillation detection and pause semantics.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: branch=autofallback-ux-pause, owner=priya — estimated deploy in 12m.
mike: small follow-up — add 'simulate pause' in staging so we can validate telemetry before prod.
alyssa: perfect. can we sync tomorrow 10am to review mock and API?
sam: yes. I'll bring the runbook.
alyssa: thanks team :thumbsup:
